title: N-AALP Carriage Protocol-Id Registry
description: Schema for the JSON representation of vectors/registry/protocols.csv: an array of row objects, one per assigned carriage protocol-id. protocol_id is an 8-bit hex code point; class is the carriage class the protocol maps onto (JSONRPC/HTTP/MSG/STREAM/DOC/OPAQUE); range is the registration range (standards 0x01-0x0F Spec Required, experimental 0x10-0x7F, private 0x80-0xFF). Format/required/enum defects are caught here; DUPLICATE protocol_id values are caught by the companion scripts/validate_registries.py.

protocol_id.description: 8-bit carriage protocol identifier, hex-prefixed, exactly 2 hex digits (e.g. 0x01).

name.description: Protocol name; MUST be non-empty (e.g. MCP).

class.description: The carriage class this protocol maps onto (ADR-0005).

range.description: Registration range: standards (0x01-0x0F, Specification Required), experimental (0x10-0x7F), or private (0x80-0xFF).

reference.description: Reference (e.g. design section 13.4); MUST be non-empty.
